text:
olivia: FYI support flagged a tenant that sends lots of small JSON strings and gets routed to slowpath because our preflight treats any string starting with '{' as "json" and skips dims inference. Causing cost spikes.
sam: repro?
olivia: sanitized request: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"open-embed-v2","input":["{\"event\":\"click\",\"url\":\"/home\"}","hello world"]}'
```
olivia: preflight: items=2, sample_lens=[48,11], parse_hint=looks_like_json, inferred_dims=null, routing=slowpath for item 0
pj: We originally did that because parsing JSON is cheap but ambiguous. But many customers embed small JSONish blobs that are actually text.
sam: proposal: when parse succeeds, check for a short string-only key like "text" or if total JSON size < 1KB and one-off keys -> treat as text candidate. Otherwise leave as json.
pj: telemetry: emit tag `preflight.json_hint` with values `struct_like|text_like|ambiguous`. Add metric `preflight.textlike_inferred` for monitoring.
ui-bot: UI request: add console hint on request trace "preflight: text-like JSON; inferred dims used" when that path chosen. Link to docs.
olivia: also add a quick SDK helper that runs a tiny heuristic: prefer X-Embed-Dims when your input looks like serialized objects. We'll draft a PR.
sam: rollout plan: feature flag `preflight_json_text_heuristic` default OFF. Canary 5% for 48h. Monitor preflight.infer_attempts, billing.delta, and errors.
ops-bot: Created INF-3001 "preflight: heuristic to infer text dims from small JSON blobs" assigned to @sam and @pj.
pj: also put a safety: never infer for items > 8KB or batch_count > 512. Keeps CPU bounded.
sam: OK I'll open server PR and add the telemetry fields. Olivia please draft the SDK note and UI copy.
olivia: on it, will ping when screenshots ready.
